plan.title: Route directive session:start through native TS runSessionStart on npm installs

narratives.Description: On npm consumer projects, session:start is aliased to the framework-commands Python bridge, which resolves frameworkRoot to the npm package tree instead of .deft/core and fails with ModuleNotFoundError for session_start. The TS implementation already exists in @deftai/directive-core/session. This story registers session:start as a native TS inline handler (matching the doctor pattern) so consumer ritual recording works without Python on the deposit path.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
Update packages/cli/src/dispatch.ts to route session:start to a native handler that calls runSessionStart(projectRoot) from @deftai/directive-core/session instead of framework-commands session_start:main.
Extend packages/cli/src/gates-cli/session-ritual-cli.test.ts and packages/core/src/session/session-start.ts tests to assert npm-layout projects record .deft/ritual-state.json; document or handle empty-git-repo HEAD resolution as a follow-on edge case.
narratives.UserStory: As a consumer on the npm install path, I want directive session:start to record ritual state without Python, so that AGENTS.md session-start and verify:session-ritual work on greenfield projects.
